title: Ashland City Master Suite
description:
A spacious home, small town bed & breakfast which offers a private master bedroom, equipped with full ensuite bathroom, private lounge room, smart-tv and walk-in closet. It is in the main area of Ashland City so there is a variety of shops and restaurants nearby. It’s 35 minutes from downtown Nashville and 5 minutes from the Cumberland River. As well as lots of nature activities to do! Couples, friends and solo travelers welcome!

The space
A shared 3 bedroom, 3 bathroom house in quite little neighborhood. 5 minutes from Cumberland River and 35 minutes away from DOWNTOWN NASHVILLE. There is a variety of  nearby restaurants such as Sidelines grille, Japanese hibachi,  Don Chuys, plenty of convenience stores and medical centers all within 5 miles from property!

Guest access
Your will have access to a private bedroom, which is equipped with a comfy king-size bed, en-suite full-bath, large walk-in closet, smart-tv , and a private lounge room. The only spaces that guests will share access are the living room, dining room, kitchen, outdoor back patio, and parking.

During your stay
You will be able to communicate with the host via email, txt or call.

Other things to note
Just a good ole fashioned bed & breakfast , the host ( Nick ) actually lives 10 min away so incase problems do occur, guests can expect immediate care. We welcome you to come enjoy a visit in our small town of Ashland City!
